scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.
limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React TreeView with ui-tree-view at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 row, indent and gap from resolveTreeView; 3 no border; 4 no nesting; 5 rows are 7u; 6 no composite; 7 selected on the primary subtle fill; 8 density leaves rows alone; 9 no floating layer; 10 fills and truncates labels; 11 rows take the focus ring.
